records.excerpt: Xiaomi retained third place with 31.2 million shipments, down 26% YoY, representing a second consecutive quarter of decline.
records.statement: Omdia报告称2026年第二季度小米全球智能手机出货3120万台，同比下降26%，仍居第三；这是机构出货口径，不是终端零售销量或经本平台独立统计的结果。

records.excerpt: Samsung retained its position as the world's largest smartphone vendor, shipping 60.5 million units (+5% YoY) for a 22% market share.
records.statement: 同一Omdia报告称三星为全球最大智能手机厂商，2026年第二季度出货6050万台，市场份额22%；用于同期间同口径的竞争比较。
